p.span: Object storage is assumed to be a hosted service. Otherwise, it requires its own VM and setup.

Persistent data services (DBMS and object storage) are hosted in a separate VPC network. Connections between the application and data networks are secured using mTLS or a VPN. Dedicated network links are preferred if the networks are geographically separated.
